setup_fastcsp_logger: setup a centralized FastCSP logger with configurable file and console output handlers
print_fastcsp_header: print the FastCSP project header with restart info and executing stages to the logger
log_config_pretty: log a configuration dictionary in a readable pretty-printed JSON format to the logger
get_fastcsp_logger: get or create a FastCSP logger instance from a config dictionary and root directory
log_error: log an error with its type and full traceback in a standardized format to the logger
